name: NODE_ENV
value: production

name: DATABASE_URL
value: <REQUIRED — the read/write user of the application; without it the installation wizard runs instead of the application; @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/database-url/) — mssql://wansurvey_app:...@<server>.database.windows.net:1433/wansurvey>

name: DATABASE_ADMIN_URL
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when the application applies the migrations itself at start (zip deployment) or makes the first administrator; leave it out when the DBA ran the installation scripts; @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/database-admin-url/) — the owner login, for the migrations applied at start>

name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
value: <REQUIRED — encrypts stored secrets; do not change it once there is data; @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/encryption-key/) — 32 bytes, base64>

name: DATABASE_SCHEMA
value: dbo

name: DATABASE_MANAGE_USERS
value: true

name: DATABASE_READONLY_URL
value: <OPTIONAL — mssql://survey_ro:…@<server>:1433/<database>: a user that reads only the analysis model (the bi_ tables and views)>

name: PUBLIC_URL
value: <REQUIRED — the public address of the application (links in e-mails, the Microsoft redirect); https://encuestas.example.org>

name: ORG_NAME
value: <OPTIONAL — recommended: the organisation that runs this installation, shown in About and in the privacy policy>

name: PRIVACY_CONTACT
value: <OPTIONAL — recommended: an e-mail or postal address where people write about their data>

name: APP_BUILD
value: <OPTIONAL — the commit or pipeline run deployed, shown in About to people who signed in>

name: APP_HOLDER
value: <OPTIONAL — who holds the rights over the application, shown in About>

name: PUBLIC_SURVEY_URL
value: <OPTIONAL — only when respondents' survey links use another address than PUBLIC_URL>

name: ENTRA_AUTHORITY_HOST
value: https://login.microsoftonline.com

name: PASSWORD_LOGIN
value: false

name: PASSWORD_2FA_REQUIRED
value: true

name: ENTRA_TENANT_ID
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when sign-in is Microsoft only (PASSWORD_LOGIN=false) or the deployment has its own directory; ENTRA_TENANT_ID, ENTRA_CLIENT_ID, ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET and ENTRA_REDIRECT_URI: all four or none; directory (tenant) id, a GUID>

name: ENTRA_CLIENT_ID
value: <CONDITIONAL — one of the four ENTRA settings that come together: all four or none; application (client) id, a GUID>

name: ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET
value: <CONDITIONAL — one of the four ENTRA settings that come together: all four or none; the client secret, or @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/entra-client-secret/)>

name: ENTRA_REDIRECT_URI
value: <CONDITIONAL — one of the four ENTRA settings that come together: all four or none; https://encuestas.example.org/api/auth/entra/callback — the redirect URI registered in Entra>

name: ENTRA_AUTO_PROVISION
value: true

name: ENTRA_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
value: <OPTIONAL — comma-separated e-mail domains the directory serves; empty: those of each organisation; example.org>

name: INITIAL_ADMIN_USER
value: <CONDITIONAL — required once, on a new installation with no organisation (needs DATABASE_ADMIN_URL and the ENTRA_* settings); remove it afterwards; UPN of the first administrator in Entra ID, e.g. ana@example.org; needed once, on a new installation>

name: SINGLE_TENANT
value: false

name: GEOCODER
value: none

name: GEOCODER_URL
value: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org

name: GEOCODER_EMAIL
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when GEOCODER=nominatim: the contact e-mail that Nominatim's usage policy asks for>

name: MAILER
value: smtp

name: MAIL_OUTBOX_DIR
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when MAILER=file: a folder>

name: SMTP_URL
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when MAILER=smtp; @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/smtp-url/) — smtps://user:password@smtp.example.org:465>

name: MAIL_FROM
value: <CONDITIONAL — set it when MAILER=smtp: the sender of the e-mails (the default points to localhost); WanSurvey <encuestas@example.org>>

name: MAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET
value: <OPTIONAL — secret of the e-mail provider's bounce webhook; @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/secrets/mail-webhook-secret/) — at least 16 characters>

name: EXPORT_STORAGE
value: blob

name: DATA_DIR
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when EXPORT_STORAGE=local: a folder (never in production)>

name: AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when EXPORT_STORAGE=blob (always in production) unless AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING is used; storage account name>

name: AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER
value: exports

name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
value: <CONDITIONAL — only with a user-assigned managed identity (Key Vault references, Blob Storage); not with a system-assigned one; client id of the app's user-assigned managed identity>

name: AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING
value: <OPTIONAL — Azurite or development storage; in Azure use the managed identity instead, so there is no key to keep>

name: WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS
value: false

name: SMS_PROVIDER
value: console

name: SMS_OUTBOX_DIR
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when SMS_PROVIDER=file: a folder>

name: SMS_CONNECTION_STRING
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when SMS_PROVIDER=acs: the Azure Communication Services connection string (a secret)>

name: SMS_FROM
value: <CONDITIONAL — required when SMS_PROVIDER=acs: the sender number>

name: SMS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
value: <OPTIONAL — secret the SMS provider sends with replies (STOP), at least 16 characters>

name: AZURE_STORAGE_AUDIO_CONTAINER
value: interview-audio

name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
value: <OPTIONAL — push notifications: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and VAPID_SUBJECT, all three or none (pnpm --filter @wansurvey/api vapid makes the keys)>

name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
value: <OPTIONAL — push notifications: all three VAPID settings or none; a secret>

name: VAPID_SUBJECT
value: <OPTIONAL — push notifications: all three VAPID settings or none; mailto:you@example.org or an https address>

name: WEB_DIST
value: /home/site/wwwroot/public

name: LOG_LEVEL
value: info

name: APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING
value: <OPTIONAL — InstrumentationKey=<guid>;IngestionEndpoint=https://<region>.in.applicationinsights.azure.com/: failures of the server are reported to Application Insights, without personal data>

name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
value: <OPTIONAL — not wired yet: leave it out>

name: NODE_OPTIONS
value: --max-old-space-size=2048

name: SCM_DO_BUILD_DURING_DEPLOYMENT
value: false
